summary: The position property changes how an element is placed. relative keeps it in place but makes it a reference point, absolute places it inside that reference point, and sticky keeps it on screen while you scroll.
notes: The badge uses top: -10px and right: -10px, so it hangs over the card's top right corner.
Without position: relative on .card, the badge would be placed relative to the page instead.
Scroll inside the Fall schedule box: the blue heading stays at the top because of position: sticky.
pitfall: Setting position: sticky with no top value. It then behaves like a normal element and never sticks.
